reason: Integrates ZenMux’s hosted language models into DeepSeek Harness, providing browser OAuth, token refresh, model catalog search, and protocol-specific model routing.

summaries.en: Integrates ZenMux-hosted language models into DeepSeek Harness with browser OAuth sign-in, model catalog search, and protocol-specific request routing.
